messages:
Maya R.: Quick thread to sync on recurring incident patterns from last quarter and lock remediation owners/timelines.
Samir: TL;DR top recurring causes: model cache evictions -> SLO hits, runtime OOMs during long prompts, flaky infra nodes (network).
Oliver T.: Ran a grep over postmortems: cache_eviction: 7, oom: 5, node_flap: 4.
Jin (oncall): Can we map which have open remediation tickets? I can paste IDs.
Maya R.: Yes please paste — I'll centralize and mark owners.
Jin (oncall): Cache evicts => INF-428, INF-442, INF-459; OOMs => INF-401, INF-436; Node flap => INF-450
Samir: Proposed remediation sketch: cache -> prefix-aware KV caching + eviction alerting (owner: @Oliver T., est 3w). OOMs -> allocator tuning + p95 mem target & canary (owner: @Jin, est 2w). Node-flap -> replace faulty image + add node-drain healthchecks (owner: @Sasha, est 1w).
Maya R.: Also need runbook snippets + test harness for cache eviction scenarios — assign to @Samir.
ops-bot: action created INF-480 by @Maya R. (task: add prefix-check to cache policy), due 2024-04-12
Samir: I’ll take INF-480. Test plan: 10k small requests + simulated long prompt burst.
Oliver T.: Alloc tuning needs perf windows with dedicated capacity. Looping in eng-infra channel.
Sasha: I’ll claim node-flap remediation. Will validate image and run a canary deploy tomorrow morning.
Maya R.: Let’s do weekly 15-min checkpoint calls — first sync Thu 09:30 PST. If blocked, escalate to Eng SRE lead.
Jin (oncall): I’ll track in the shared sheet and update tickets as we progress. Link: https://redwood-internal/notes/recurring-incidents-q1
Maya R.: Also proposing a thematic fix: improve incident templates to capture rollback/root causal event. @Product-SRE can you own the template draft?
Product-SRE: Yep — will draft new template and example by EOD Friday.
Maya R.: Thanks all — I’ll summarize action items after this thread and pin to #incidents. :party_parrot: 
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly checkpoint created, calendar invite sent.
